import 'package:context/context.dart';
import 'package:web_server/web_server.dart';

void main() {
  final exchange = HttpExchange();
  final context = Context().withHttp(exchange);
  context.http.respond('Hello');
  if (!identical(context.http, exchange) ||
      exchange.responses.single != 'Hello') {
    throw StateError('HTTP exchange was not supplied to the context');
  }
  if (!identical(HttpContext(context).http, exchange)) {
    throw StateError('Named extension invocation failed');
  }
}
